games.name: Count the Dots
games.what: Dot patterns flash on the screen and the player taps how many there are, from 1 to 9. Five short rounds.

games.name: Which is Bigger?
games.what: Two numbers side by side and the player taps the bigger one. Five short rounds, from single digits to two-digit numbers.

games.name: Which Group Has More?
games.what: Two groups of dots and the player taps the side with more. No counting needed: it is about a feel for quantity.

games.name: Place the Number
games.what: A number appears and the player slides a marker to where it belongs on a line from 0 to 100. Three rounds.

games.name: Remember the Digits
games.what: A few digits appear one at a time, then disappear, and the player types them back in order. Three rounds that get longer.
